experiment.topic: Mean reversion of hourly realized volatility in BTC-USD under volatility compression regime
experiment.hypothesis: Volatility compression in BTC-USD, measured by hourly realized volatility, exhibits mean reversion when the 30-period rolling volatility exceeds 8% of daily returns, with reversion occurring within 12 hours of the peak.

test.note: No misleading proxy: hypothesis requires unavailable inputs or rule expression.

experiment.falsification_test: If the 30-period rolling realized volatility in BTC-USD exceeds 0.08 and fails to revert to a mean within the next 12 hours, despite being above its 30-period rolling average, then the hypothesis is falsified.
